anatomy.flutter: One CartesianChart StatefulWidget covering all three families via ChartSeriesSpec.kind (ChartSeriesKind.area|bar|line), with _CartesianLayout.resolve() computing frame/scales/gridLines/xTicks/yTicks/areas/lines/bars/dots/labels, and _CartesianPainter drawing grid -> cursor band -> areas/lines/dots (clipped for entrance) -> bars, matching the doc comment's own claim that 'recharts makes them one widget too — CartesianChart with a different chartName'.
anatomy.web: Three distinct Recharts component exports composed per demo function in components/ds/charts/{area,bar,line}.tsx — AreaChart+Area+CartesianGrid+XAxis+YAxis+ChartTooltip+ChartLegend, BarChart+Bar+..., LineChart+Line+... — each wrapped in the shared ChartContainer/ChartTooltipContent/ChartLegendContent from ui/chart.tsx, documented on the chart-cartesian doc page as 'the real AreaChart / BarChart / LineChart from components/ds/charts/{area,bar,line}.tsx'.

api.flutter: CartesianChart({data, series, margin = ChartMargin.standard, layout, grid, xAxis, yAxis, legend, tooltip, stackOffsetExpand}); ChartAxis({dataKey, type, tickLine, axisLine, tickMargin, minTickGap, tickCount, hide, tickFormatter, size}); ChartSeriesSpec({kind, dataKey, stroke, fill, fillOpacity, strokeWidth, curve, stackId, radii, cellFills, dot, labels, gradient}).
api.web: Recharts' own AreaChart/BarChart/LineChart props (data, margin, layout) plus CartesianGrid(horizontal, vertical), XAxis/YAxis(dataKey, tickLine, axisLine, tickMargin, minTickGap, tickCount, hide, tickFormatter), and Area/Bar/Line(dataKey, stroke, fill, fillOpacity, strokeWidth, type="linear"|"natural"|"monotone"|"step", stackId, radius, LabelList, dot).

states.flutter: _hover (int? index) tracked via MouseRegion.onHover -> layout.indexAt(local), driving both the tooltip's active index and the cursor highlight band (`cursor && activeIndex != null && layout.bars.isNotEmpty`); entrance uses an AnimationController seeded at 1 and reset to 0->1 on non-zero motion duration.
states.web: Recharts' own hover/active-index state (payload/label passed to ChartTooltipContent on mouseover) plus `[&_.recharts-rectangle.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:fill-muted` sweep in ui/chart.tsx for the cursor band; entrance via recharts' `animationDuration`/`animationEasing` (through useChartMotion()).

disabled.flutter: CartesianChart has no disabled concept -- it is a read-only data visualisation.
disabled.web: None of AreaChart/BarChart/LineChart expose a disabled prop.
disabled.note: A chart is not a control; this dimension does not apply to either implementation.

interaction.flutter: MouseRegion.onHover/onExit drives _hover via layout.indexAt(local) (nearest categoryCoord to the pointer's x or y depending on layout.horizontal), which is the direct analogue of recharts' own nearest-category tooltip activation; no keyboard interaction is implemented for hovering a specific datum on either side.
interaction.web: Recharts resolves the active tooltip index from pointer position against its internal category scale on mousemove/mouseover; no keyboard-driven datum selection is documented on the chart-cartesian page either.

semantics.flutter: _TickLabel renders tick text through StyledText at ChartText.xs/mutedForeground or TextStyles.numberSm depending on _AxisTick.isNumeric, matching chart.dart's documented AA fix of always painting muted-foreground on every tick label rather than leaving a hardcoded grey.
semantics.web: ui/chart.tsx's ChartContainer className sweeps [&_.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick-value]:fill-muted-foreground onto every axis tick across all three cartesian families, per the file's own documented AA-contrast fix.
